ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var cols = vars.raCols default [] var reqs = vars.raReqs default [] fun subtreeIds(id: String): Array<String> = [id] ++ flatten((cols filter ((c) -> c.parent_id == id)) map ((c) -> subtreeIds(c.id))) fun callRequestIdsIn(stepsJson) = ((read(stepsJson default "[]", "application/json")) filter ((s) -> s.'type' == "callRequest")) map ((s) -> s.requestId) var calledIds = flatten(reqs map ((r) -> callRequestIdsIn(r.pre_request_json) ++ callRequestIdsIn(r.post_response_json))) var scopeIds = subtreeIds(vars.raCollectionId) --- reqs filter ((r) -> (scopeIds contains r.collection_id) and !(calledIds contains r.id)) map ((r) -> {id: r.id, name: r.name})

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var passed = sizeOf(vars.raResults filter ((r) -> r.status == "success")) var failed = sizeOf(vars.raResults) - passed --- { collectionId: vars.raCollectionId, collectionName: (vars.raColRow[0]).name default vars.raCollectionId, runAt: now(), totalRequests: sizeOf(vars.raResults), passedRequests: passed, failedRequests: failed, durationMs: (now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}) - vars.raStartMs, results: vars.raResults }
